origin: Question selected after post-hoc exposed-author audit of 23 existing answers; not preregistration of the old study and not evidence of a confirmed mechanism.
question: When a target attribute relation is absent from a document packet, does the answer assign a same-attribute value from a different named entity to the target, and does replacing that distractor value change the adopted value?
current_scope: Design document only. No source sampling, finalized materials, executable collector, new forward pass, generation or study registration has occurred.
probe_role: No probe required for primary outcomes; no re-training, layer selection, calibration or threshold search.

material_plan.family: Fresh explicitly fictional entity-attribute records, not original release facts or held-out 380 questions
material_plan.answer_values: Three distinct opaque values per base: target t, distractors v1/v2. Fixed generated assignment before outputs, with role/position balancing specified in the later material spec; no selecting labels by tokenizer behavior or model answers.
material_plan.question: Ask only the stipulated target entity's one attribute according to the supplied records. Do not include the answer value in the question.
material_plan.documents: Five short fictional records with explicit entity identities. One target relation, one different entity's same attribute, and three invariant background records. Preserve slot order and distractor entity between four cells.
material_plan.S: Target record explicitly supplies value t. The non-target value is either v1 or v2; both are compatible with the target because entity identities differ.
material_plan.I: Replace only the target attribute sentence with an entity-presence statement. No target attribute value remains in the rendered question or five documents. Distractor sentence otherwise matches S.
constraints: v1 and v2 must differ from t and each other; no substring or alias collisions.
Exclude lexical definitions, implicit class membership, overview counting, ambiguous names, causal modifiers and pronouns.
For every I packet, construct two explicit completions assigning different target values, both compatible with all provided records. These are audit witnesses and are never shown to the model.
The later material spec must fix identifier/value assignment, ordering and seed before generation; this draft does not claim these are finalized.
Record token lengths. Removing a target fact changes content and may change length; do not claim a pure hidden-state or token-length mechanism.
Do not add paraphrase variants, instruction candidates, retries of completed answers or a second sample after observing outcomes.

generation_plan.template: Reuse the existing chat free-answer instruction and native chat renderer after fingerprinting; fictional short records are a new input distribution.
generation_plan.decoding: greedy, max_new_tokens=128, one saved answer per cell
generation_plan.smoke: At most four selected cells included within 48, not additional answers; exact selection and technical checks must be fixed in collection preparation.
generation_plan.launch: Prepare code, CPU source/render checks and estimates first. If runtime cannot be guaranteed below 10 minutes, user launches under the existing division of work. No runnable collector exists at draft time.

outcomes.primary: All I outputs: assigns that cell's non-target distractor value to the target. Denominator 24 if all 12 bases are prepared; preserve invalid/ambiguous cases in denominator.
outcomes.paired_descriptive: For each of 12 bases, whether I-v1 adopts v1 and I-v2 adopts v2; retain all four cells, do not select bases by S success.
outcomes.controls: All S outputs: correct target value and supported attribution; denominator 24. Report both distractor settings. Poor S performance limits a missing-relation-specific interpretation.
secondary: I acknowledgment followed by substantive target answer
output citation supports the claimed target relation
outcomes.coding: Separate assigns-target-value from mentions-value, quotes-background and explicitly rejects-value. Multiple candidate adoption or unclear retraction can remain unknown. Keep raw outputs and quoted spans.
outcomes.statistics: Full counts and unknown identification bounds; descriptive paired base tables. If bootstrap intervals are reported, resample all four cells together across 12 bases, 10000 repeats, seed42. No significance search or success-selected slices.

interpretation_limits: Fictional stipulated facts test entity-attribute binding under this task, not natural-document semantic generalization or real-world answer correctness.
A distractor replacement response concerns the edited input. It does not identify hidden-state causal use, parameter memory, subjective knowledge or deliberate disregard.
Author construction and deterministic input checks are not independent semantic approval. Expose actual reviewers and context if review occurs.
Original one-fit budget remains exhausted; the draft cannot reopen it or reuse seen eval as prospective confirmation.
The original 380 held-out test questions remain untouched.
